features.name: any_pivot_concession_word_comment
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment contain however, nevertheless, or nonetheless?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as a JSON list of strings. Return 1 if any comment matches case-insensitive regex r'\b(however|nevertheless|nonetheless)\b', else 0. Empty list gives 0; missing or malformed JSON gives null. Raw text match, no semantic filtering; may include quoted text or text from outcome announcements.

h0: any_pivot_concession_word_comment has no association with whether the OP changed their view.
h1: Rows with a counter-argument containing a pivot concession word have a higher rate of OP view change.
note: Persuasiveness is operationalized as the dataset outcome delta (OP view change), an association only. Row-level presence of the words in any counter-argument is used; the hypothesis could instead concern share of comments or per-comment effects, and per-comment outcomes are not supplied. Matching is literal: it does not check that the word is used as a pivot concession, may match quoted text, and the comments could contain outcome-related text. Comment timing is unknown.
